name: hris-admin-panel
context: Design an admin CRUD panel for HR management operations. The audience is HR administrators who manage employee records, departments, roles, and organizational data. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet. The interface must support bulk operations, advanced filtering, inline editing, and role-based action visibility while maintaining data integrity through confirmation dialogs and audit trail indicators.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for table headers, cell data, and action labels
Apply color.rules.json feedback tokens for status badges (active, inactive, pending)
Table layout must support sortable columns, resizable widths, and fixed header on scroll
Destructive actions (delete, deactivate) must trigger confirmation dialogs
Inline edit mode must visually differentiate from read mode using border/surface tokens
Pagination must support both page-based and load-more patterns
Comply with Quality_Gate: clear data hierarchy, no ambiguous status labels, proper table semantics

outputCriteria.format: Admin panel spec with data table, CRUD modals, filter bar, bulk action toolbar, and pagination using token references
qualityChecks: Table uses proper HTML table semantics with sortable column headers
Status badges use distinct feedback tokens with icon+text (not color alone)
Filter bar maintains visibility of active filter count and clear-all option
Bulk action toolbar appears contextually when rows are selected
Empty and error states provide actionable guidance
accessibilityRequirements: Table headers use scope and aria-sort for sortable columns
Row selection checkboxes have aria-label with employee identifier
Confirmation dialogs trap focus and return focus on dismiss
Filter controls are grouped in a form with submit and reset actions
Pagination announces current page and total to screen readers

examples.description: Employee data table with filters, bulk actions, and inline status editing
examples.output:
Page: AdminPanel
  Layout: flex(direction=column, gap=space.md)
  padding: var(--space-lg)
  Children:
    - Molecule: PageHeader(flex, justify=space-between)
        - Atom: Heading(level=h1, token=typography.heading.lg, text='Employees')
        - Atom: Button(variant=primary, icon=plus, label='Add employee')
    - Molecule: FilterBar(flex, gap=space.sm, padding=space.sm)
        bg: var(--color-surface-secondary)
        radius: var(--radius-md)
        - Atom: Input(type=search, placeholder='Search by name...', icon=search)
        - Atom: Select(label='Department', options=['All','Engineering','HR','Sales'])
        - Atom: Select(label='Status', options=['All','Active','Inactive','Pending'])
        - Atom: Badge(text='3 filters active', variant=info)
        - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, size=sm, label='Clear all')
    - Molecule: BulkActionBar(hidden when 0 selected, motion=enter-exit.slide-down)
        bg: var(--color-surface-elevated)
        padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, text='4 selected')
        - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='Export')
        - Atom: Button(variant=destructive, label='Deactivate')
    - Organism: DataTable(overflow-x=auto)
        - thead: Row(bg=color.surface.secondary, position=sticky, top=0)
            - Atom: Checkbox(ariaLabel='Select all', indeterminate)
            - Atom: ColumnHeader(text='Name', sortable, aria-sort=ascending)
            - Atom: ColumnHeader(text='Department', sortable)
            - Atom: ColumnHeader(text='Status', sortable)
            - Atom: ColumnHeader(text='Actions')
        - tbody: Row(hover: bg=color.surface.hover)
            - Atom: Checkbox(ariaLabel='Select John Doe')
            - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, text='John Doe')
            - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, text='Engineering')
            - Atom: Badge(text='Active', icon=check-circle, bg=color.feedback.success-subtle)
            - Molecule: RowActions
                - Atom: IconButton(icon=edit, ariaLabel='Edit employee')
                - Atom: IconButton(icon=trash, ariaLabel='Delete employee', color=color.feedback.error)
    - Molecule: Pagination(flex, justify=space-between)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, text='Showing 1-20 of 156')
        - Molecule: PageControls(aria-label='Pagination')
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='Previous', disabled)
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='1', aria-current=page)
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='2')
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='Next')
acceptanceCriteria: Table uses semantic thead/tbody with sortable headers and aria-sort
Status badges combine icon and color for non-color-dependent communication
Bulk action bar appears with motion when rows selected
Filter bar shows active count and clear option
Row actions use icon buttons with descriptive aria-labels
